notes.title: Two great DLC! Soon!
notes.content:
Hello! Dear friends, I haven't made a game for a long time.

Over the past few years, many tragic and joyful things have happened in my life.
I'm sad because my father died... 
And I'm happy, because I became a dad for the second time.
I didn't have time to develop games.

But now I'm working again! Now I'm making games in Unreal Engine.

I want to show you two DLC - it will be cool!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3544630/100_hidden_cats__The_Island_DLC/]100 hidden cats - The Island DLC[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2518290/100_hidden_cats__The_Mill_DLC/]100 hidden cats - The Mill DLC[/url]

Thank you very much!
